jobs.detail: Neutrophil granule contact: cyan-white core snap with two tiny lime vesicle granules. F1 small ivory four-prong impact with cyan border and lime granule; F2 compact jagged cyan petal burst 55%tile, lime pellets split; F3 broken cyan membrane shock ring 72%tile with four outward short dash accents, EMPTY center; F4 six short cyan/lime granule streaks moving away; F5 four sparse cyan/lime fragments, F6 two tiny cyan dots. jobs.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. A real production SIX-FRAME TARGET CONTACT EFFECT for the pixel-art microscopic tower-defense game 胞卫战. Reference is palette, cell material and pixel-outline STYLE only: DO NOT draw the tower, victim, characters, ground, UI or words. Layout EXACTLY THREE COLUMNS by TWO ROWS, six equal invisible square cells, 3:2 landscape canvas, frame order left to right top row1-3 then bottom row4-6. One complete separate effect per cell; same center, orientation and scale across all six. All pixels of each effect within central76% of each tile, minimum12% genuinely TRANSPARENT padding on each side, transparent centers after initial contact flash so the actual enemy is readable underneath. Fixed flat orthographic top-down view. Strict clean PIXEL ART, hand-placed square clusters and stepped outlines, at most24 colors, 2-3 bounded shades per material, dark muted teal/plum contours rather than black, ivory white accents. No 3D perspective, blur, soft glow, gradients, smoke, gritty noise, flames, blood, swords or magic runes. Six DISTINCT sequential drawn poses: instant compact contact, strongest snap, outward/inward motion, broken afterimage, sparse fading flecks, final tiny remains. Do not simply recolor or scale one shape. Contact feedback should feel fast, biological and tangible. SPECIFIC EFFECT: Neutrophil granule contact: cyan-white core snap with two tiny lime vesicle granules. F1 small ivory four-prong impact with cyan border and lime granule; F2 compact jagged cyan petal burst 55%tile, lime pellets split; F3 broken cyan membrane shock ring 72%tile with four outward short dash accents, EMPTY center; F4 six short cyan/lime granule streaks moving away; F5 four sparse cyan/lime fragments, F6 two tiny cyan dots. The dominant shape is crisp cyan fragmentation, not a flower or spiky creature.

jobs.name: 抗体_标记附着
jobs.detail: Antibody marking/attachment, NO damage explosion. Honey-gold Y-shaped antibody proteins latch to an unseen circular bacterial surface. F1 two tiny golden Y proteins approaching the center from opposite diagonals; F2 THREE golden Y-shaped receptors click inward on a compact ivory-gold clasp flash; F3 open thin golden segmented ring with THREE outward Ys, center EMPTY; F4 the gold ring separates into three short arcs with Ys still connected; F5 three tiny golden fork tips/flecks; F6 two tiny warm gold motes. Visually warm gold and pale ivory, tiny cyan accents only. Clear elastic CLICK and persistent-looking attachment afterimage, not a bullet explosion, no central nucleus or enemy drawn.

jobs.name: 巨噬_吞噬收拢
jobs.detail: Macrophage engulf/contact effect: TWO cyan-white pseudopod crescents sweep inward around an unseen enemy, forcefully close and collapse into amber digestion granules. F1 broad opposed thin cyan arcs beginning to curl inward, center empty; F2 arcs curl closer, four short ivory contact ticks; F3 maximum pinching closure with a small amber-white compact contact knot at center; F4 cyan folds recoil and dissolve into small amber/cyan vesicles; F5 only four amber digestion granules; F6 two tiny teal/amber motes. Motion direction is clearly INWARD for swallowing, not a generic outward shock explosion. No full cell body, no nucleus, no mouth/teeth/face, no drawn enemy.

jobs.name: 壁垒_纤维回弹
jobs.detail: A reactive FIBRIN FIBER impact ripple when an enemy physically strikes the barrier. F1 two short ivory-cyan crossing fiber strokes bend inward under contact; F2 tight woven four-loop knot with tiny mint compression ticks; F3 elastic outward rebound, four bowed cyan-white strands form an OPEN square-diamond lattice ripple, EMPTY center; F4 lattice breaks into four curved fiber pieces moving outward; F5 four small mint-white fiber dashes; F6 two tiny mint fragments. The effect reads as elastic protein mesh tension and recoil, not a weapon attack, no shield icon, no whole cell or solid ring disk.

jobs.name: 神经_脉冲接触
jobs.detail: Neural synapse contact/discharge: ice-cyan, pale electric lavender and ivory-white. F1 tiny sharp ivory diamond spark with cyan rim; F2 four branching short angular cyan-white electrical strokes snap radially, compact center; F3 hollow broken cyan/lavender pulse ring with four zigzag branches pointing outward; F4 branches split into eight short angular signal dashes, EMPTY center; F5 four sparse lavender/cyan fragments; F6 two tiny cyan square motes. Very crisp stepped pixel zigzags, no blurry lightning, no electric cloud, no runes, no full cell. A brief precise electrical SNAP rather than firework.
